what: Post-revise round-meta refresh still uses an executable-path guard and invokes a single script path
scenario_or_breakage: After deleting scripts/write-design-round-meta.sh, a default of python/cli.py progress write-design-round-meta will not pass [[ -x "$_rmd_sh" ]], so revise.status/tier never get written and Review Phase Detail stays stale
suggested_fix: Replace the _rmd_sh/-x block with an unconditional python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/python/cli.py" progress write-design-round-meta --round-dir ... call (or a fixed argv array); drop the -x gate; keep WRITE_DESIGN_ROUND_META_SH only as an explicit test override that also uses argv form, not a retired .sh default
